current_evidence: Council site search returns the 'National and Local List of Validation Requirements' at the -02-02-2026 URL, whose cover reads 'Adopted 2 February 2026 v1.3' and whose version history runs to 'V1.3 06-08-2026', so it is the same latest version that Grokbot's -06-08-2026 filename refers to, but Grokbot's URL returned a client error twice while the -02-02-2026 URL on the same site loaded fine.

issues.detail: Grokbot's validation list URL (...validation-national-and-local-list-06-08-2026) failed twice with a client error, even though other documents on the same site loaded. The same v1.3 list is now served at ...validation-national-and-local-list-02-02-2026, so the workbook link should point there.
issues.evidence: Working URL cover: 'Adopted 2 February 2026 v1.3'; version history 'V1.3 06-08-2026 – change made.'

issues.detail: List date is recorded as 2026-02-01, but the document says it was adopted on 2 February 2026. It has also been revised three times since (latest v1.3, 6 August 2026), and the workbook does not record that.

Grokbot missed these local requirements: (13) Aerodrome and/or radar impact assessment, for any proposal that could affect aviation (bird hazard in airport safeguarding areas, height over aerodrome thresholds, smoke or dust, radar interference, lighting); (18) Battery energy storage safety statement, for BESS of 1 MWh or more that are not linked to a dwelling; (19) Bio-aerosol risk assessment, for handling or treating biodegradable waste, including composting, within 250 m of homes or sensitive workplaces; (30) National Landscapes assessment of need statement, for major development within a National Landscape.
issues.evidence: Local list items 13, 18, 19 and 30, e.g. '18. Battery energy storage safety statement ... 1 MWh or more, excluding systems linked to a residential dwelling'

issues.detail: The 'Minerals & waste (county)' row is marked '(none)', but the list has a whole section, 'Additional requirements for minerals and waste applications' (items 48-68, about 21 requirements). Two of them, the blasting and vibration assessment (item 51) and the waste planning statement, were instead put under Full planning.
issues.evidence: Contents: 'Additional requirements for minerals and waste applications' (48-68); Grokbot Full-planning trigger '51.Blasting and vibration assessment ... For minerals proposals that involve quarry blasting'

issues.detail: Reserved matters is marked '(none)', but the source names reserved matters for several requirements: ecological surveys and the biodiversity checklist (item 23), the sustainability checklist and statement (item 43), and landscaping proposals where landscaping is being applied for (item 31). Outline is also missing from the ecology/biodiversity checklist and landscaping rows (only the sustainability items are placed under Outline). Technical details consent and permission in principle, which the source names for ecology, BNG and sustainability, are left at '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Item 23: 'Required for full, householder, outline, reserved matters, technical details consent and listed building consent applications'; item 31: 'Also required for outline and reserved matters applications where landscaping is being applied for'

issues.detail: 41 rows say 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. Many of them are wrong or too narrow. Examples: Agricultural land classification, SCI and Landscaping apply only to major development. Bio-aerosol, the waste planning statement and blasting/vibration apply to minerals and waste applications. Heritage statement, flood risk assessment, noise, trees and contamination apply to all application types, householder included. Every inferred row needs checking against its 'When it's required' text.
issues.evidence: e.g. Odour/Dust/Vibration row: 'For minerals proposals that involve quarry blasting' placed under Full planning

issues.detail: Two Householder rows contradict the source. 'Existing and proposed site levels' was placed under Householder although the quoted text says it applies to non-householder applications only. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' was placed under Householder although the source lists householder development among the sequential test exemptions (only the FRA applies to householder in Flood Zones 2/3).
issues.evidence: Grokbot's own excerpt: '(this applies to non-householder applications only). 24'; item 25 sequential test exemptions include householder works

issues.detail: The 'Change of use - prior approval' rows (Sustainability checklist, Energy/Sustainability statement, 'Validation checklist form (completed)', Floor plans, FRA, Sequential test) were inferred from the words 'change of use' in text about full/outline/RM/technical details consent planning applications, not prior approval. The sustainability checklist is explicitly limited to full, outline, RM and technical details consent. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' is a mislabelled copy of the sustainability checklist text.
issues.evidence: Item 43: 'For full planning applications, outline* and reserved matter applications, and applications for technical details consent, a completed checklist and sustainability statement is required ... including change of use/conversion'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are garbled or point to the wrong item. 'Ventilation / Extraction details' reuses the air quality assessment text instead of item 46 (Ventilation and extraction statement). 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' is a mid-sentence fragment ending in the page number '41'. 'Marketing reports' stops at 'For all applications;' with no condition. The Householder 'Ecological Survey' trigger is change-log text ('Updated 08-07-2026 – updated section numbering'). 'Planning Statement' and 'Minerals / Waste specific statements' both quote the same waste planning statement fragment ('Statement. 69 ...'). 'Sequential / Exception Test' reuses the FRA trigger.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts: '...areas at risk of flooding; 41'; 'Marketing reports When it's required For all applications;'

issues.detail: 'Photographs / Photomontages' under Householder and LBC is triggered by a sentence saying photographs OF PLANS are not acceptable. That is a drawing standard, not a requirement to submit photographs.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: '(JPG's, and photographs of plans and drawings are not acceptable because they cannot be accurately scaled)'

issues.detail: Item 12 (Other plans and drawings) requires section 73 and non-material amendment applications to mark the proposed changes on the plans, but Grokbot has '(none)' for 'Variation of condition s73' and 'Non-material amendment'. Item 40 (Structural surveys and schedules of work) appears only under LBC, taken from the LBC checklist's re-thatching text, rather than as a local list requirement.
issues.evidence: Item 12: 'Section 73 and non-material amendment applications must mark proposed changes'; contents item 'Structural surveys and schedules of work'

issues.detail: About 26 'Submission rules' tab items are process text, fees or boilerplate rather than requirements: review within 5 working days, contact us after 10 working days, closure after 21 days, the invalid-application admin charge and its fee table (£35-£250), copyright notice, privacy notice (three times), redaction of personal data, marking confidential information, email to the area planning team. The 'pre-application advice' rows (Householder, Full, LBC) only encourage use of the paid service and are not validation requirements.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'We usually start reviewing applications within 5 working days.'; 'Administration charge fees ... £100 to £500 £35'

issues.detail: Tab items under 'Policy-driven requirements' include version change-log entries ('Water quality nutrient neutrality statement v.1.1 -11-02-2026 – change made. 39.' and '...remove words technical details consent...') and bare list fragments with no trigger ('Special Protection Areas (SPAs) and potential SPAs', 'Poole Harbour SPA and RAMSAR;', 'The river Avon SAC;', 'The river Axe SAC;'). Drawing standard item 7 ends with the stray fragment 'c.'.

Submission-rule items taken from the web page repeat the same sentences from the PDF (10 working days, admin charge, copyright, privacy notice). 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' and 'Sustainability / Climate change checklist' are the same requirement (item 43), each entered separately under Full, Outline and Prior approval.

summary: Grokbot found the right current document (Dorset's National and Local List adopted 2 Feb 2026, now v1.3 of 6 Aug 2026), but its URL no longer resolves and the list date is a day out. The extraction misses aerodrome, BESS, bio-aerosol, National Landscapes and the whole minerals/waste section, wrongly gives Reserved matters no requirements, and is padded with process text and fee items.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
